description: A pure CALCULATION node — stroke a graph into mitred wall polygons: graph in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it strokes a GRAPH into one mitred wall polygon PER edge and returns them as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas.

INPUT: graph takes { "nodes": [{ "id", "x", "y" }, ...], "edges": [{ "from_node_id", "to_node_id" }, ...] } — coordinates in metres, local to the anchor. Wire Graph Geometry val-graph, or Skeleton val-branches, into valin-graph. With "Use same width for all" OFF, each edge is stroked at its own `thickness` (from Set Thickness / BSP); edges tagged type "opening" are skipped, leaving gaps.

COMBINING is delegated to other nodes: to dissolve the per-segment bands into one seamless poché use Boolean 2D (Union) or Merge; to clip the walls to a footprint use Boolean 2D (Intersect); to keep only the outer boundary use Graph Reduce "Keep Outer Boundary" upstream.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes the per-segment bands as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
